page0.text:
We run through the forest.
I'm following Tohsaka's back.
I can sense Assassin chasing us through the trees.

page1.text:
"Behind you, Emiya!"
Tohsaka should have gotten far ahead of us by now, but she slows down and turns back. She must be worried.

page2.text:
"Guh...!"
I know the enemy is right behind me.
But I can't do anything about it.
My pursuer is Assassin.
How am I supposed to shake him off with Illya in tow?

page3.text: "That's far enough. I don't need you."

page4.text:
"Eh...?"
A sinister voice growls in my ear.
I look to the side and see a face in a skull mask,
smirking and licking a dagger.

page5.text:
"Rragh!"
The white skull is blown away.
Assassin was running next to us, until someone kicked him in the stomach.

page6.text:
"...Hmph. So you can't even kill a child without resorting to an ambush? You third-rate."
Archer doesn't stop as he says it.

page7.text:
"I'll cover the rear guard. Take Illya and run.
Hurry. If that thing catches up to you, you're finished."
Archer's looking at Assassin and something else approaching from behind him.

page8.text:
...
...It's catching up.
The Shadow is corroding the ground itself as it catches up to us...!

page9.text:
"Archer...!?"
"Save the discussion for later. Run, boy. Now that you've taken Illya's hand, protect her til the very end."

page10.text:
Archer slightly slows and falls behind us.
For an instant...
Just before he leaves, he looks at Illya with a terribly sorry expression.

page11.text:
We leave the melee behind and escape the forest.
The clash behind us continues between Assassin, our pursuer, and Archer, there to head him off.

page12.text:
"Nngh..."
Assassin is forced back repeatedly, unable to go on the offensive.
He clashes evenly with Archer.
Each dagger Assassin throws at me whenever he spots an opening is shot down, leaving him clearly frustrated.
But, that isn't because he's weak.

page13.text:
"Hah, sei!"
Archer intercepts dozens of thrown daggers.
He does it with vigor unlike anything he's shown thus far.
Archer has the advantage.
I don't know why, but right now, he's fighting with demonic frenzy.

page14.text:
"Ngh... How can you move!?"
Assassin desperately parries a shot, retreating.
Archer retorts.

page15.text:
"It's simple. I'm not a proper hero like the others. I'm on the same level as that mud.
In other words..."
Archer steps back, perhaps sensing an opportunity...
"I'm also a twisted Heroic Spirit, though not as bad as you...!"
...and brings a sword down on the white mask.

page16.text:
"Geeeeeee!!!"
The black robe scrambles wildly.
Assassin flees, clutching his slashed face.

page17.text:
It isn't a temporary withdrawal, but a flight for his life.
The black-robed Servant escapes Archer and disappears into the wooded gloom.

page18.text: "Nice one! Now we don't need to worry about him chasing us!"

page19.text: "Good work, Archer. You must be tired, so go ahead and rest in spirit form."

page20.text:
Tohsaka congratulates him with palpable relief.
"RIN!"
Behind her.
"Toh—"
It boils up, as if it was born in the shade of the trees.

page21.text:
"Huh? What?"
She turns around.
Simultaneously, the Shadow's black tentacles reach out...

page22.text:
"Toh...saka..."
I won't make it in time.
I can only watch as the tentacles lance forth to impale Tohsaka...

page23.text:
"Guh..."
...but skewer Archer instead, after he pushes her out of the way.

page24.text:
"Huh...?"
Tohsaka stares up in shock at Archer.

page25.text:
...
Archer's done.
He's still breathing, and there isn't much blood.
He's been impaled, but if it isn't through a vital spot, he should be able to regenerate from it.
Still, I know that he can't fight anymore.

page26.text:
That thing kills Servants.
No matter how powerful a Heroic Spirit is, it can't beat the Shadow because it's a summoned Servant.
I just know that, somehow.

page27.text:
"No way... Archer...what are you doing?"
Does Tohsaka sense it too?
She calls out to Archer in a trembling voice, climbing to her unsteady feet, but...
"Stay away! Get out of here, you fool!"
Archer's harsh rebuke stops her in her tracks.

page28.text:
The Shadow pulsates.
This forest will die.
All of the surrounding mana is being sucked into the Shadow.

page29.text:
...
Stupidly, I think that it reminds me of a water balloon.
The balloon is engorged and still filling.
An unsavory premonition of it bursting and exploding its contents all over us flashes through my mind.

page30.text:
"Oh...crap."
We're going to be caught in it.
We'll be completely swallowed by it here.
...Archer pulls out the tentacles skewering his body, and runs at Tohsaka.
Then, I'll...
